Name: Libnah in the Wilderness
ModernLocation: Unknown; a wilderness station, possibly along Wadi el Beidha
Description: A station on Israel's wilderness journey, pitched after Rimmon-parez and before Rissah, on the numbered itinerary of Numbers 33 — a different Libnah from the Levitical city in Judah's Shephelah.
BiblicalSignificance: Libnah's place in the itinerary marks one night's camp of the wilderness generation; its name is shared with a later Judahite city, but its setting is the desert march.
